What we take on

Award us a single trade or the full package. Every scope runs under one safety and quality framework.

Fit-out and finishing

Our core trade, from the first block to the final coat.

Blockwork and masonry
Blocks, bricks and stone for walls and structural elements.
Plaster and render
Walls, ceilings and shafts, finished smooth.
Gypsum and drywall
Suspended, coffered and feature ceilings, bulkheads and fire-rated partitions.
Tiling and flooring
Tiles, marble, granite, epoxy and vinyl.
Painting and coating
Interior and exterior surfaces.
Metal and aluminium
Handrails, guardrails, windows, louvres and decorative panels.

MEP works

Five disciplines installed by trained and certified crews.

HVAC
Ductwork, chilled water piping, chillers, AHUs, FCUs and pumps.
Electrical
Conduits, cable tray and trunking, cabling, switchboards, panels, fixtures and lighting.
Plumbing and drainage
Water supply and drainage piping, plants and pumps.
Fire fighting
Piping, sprinklers and pumps, plus NOVEC and FM-200 suppression systems.
Low current
Fire alarm, voice evacuation, public address, structured cabling, security, access control, nurse call and BMS.

Civil and structural works

From structure to skin, plus the works around the building.

Structure
Reinforced concrete, steel fixing, formwork and precast installation.
Earthworks
Site preparation, excavation and backfilling.
Façade
Cladding, curtain wall, glazing, skylights and canopies.
External works
Paving, kerbs, stormwater drainage, utility lines, roads and landscaping.

Manpower supply

Skilled trades and supervision that work as an extension of your own team.

Civil and finishing trades
Shutter carpenters, steel fixers, masons, tile and marble fixers, gypsum carpenters and painters.
MEP trades
HVAC technicians, duct installers, electricians, plumbers, pipefitters and sprinkler fitters.
Metal trades
Aluminium fixers and fabricators, welders and façade installers.
Supervision

About Sareen

Sareen Company Ltd is a subcontractor based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, specialising in civil and MEP works. We support main contractors and clients on residential, commercial and industrial projects.

Our focus is safety, efficiency and meeting your programme. We work to international standards and local authority requirements, and we price to stay competitive without cutting quality.

Our affiliate, Mohammed Jassim Al Bahar Contracting Establishment (MJB), works alongside us on civil and MEP contracts, which extends our reach across the Kingdom.

  • High-rise towers
  • Shopping malls
  • Hospitals
  • Residential villas
  • Sports stadiums
  • Airports
  • District cooling plants
  • Metro stations
  • Universities and schools
  • Infrastructure

Our mission

We are committed to delivering professional civil and MEP construction services with excellence, competitiveness and competence. Our goal is to complete projects on time through proficiency and adherence to the highest standards of quality, ensuring exceptional results in both civil infrastructure and MEP systems.

As a former Senior Procurement Manager at Masah Construction Company, I led procurement for projects like Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Hospital and the Ajdan Waterfront Development Tower.

Excellence in construction begins with sourcing the right materials from trusted partners. That procurement discipline is fundamental to how we operate at Sareen.

Mohammed Abdul Hafeez20 years delivering landmark projects in KSA
